mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte wasting (particularly potassium and magnesium), while lisinopril reduces renal perfusion pressure through ACE inhibition, synergistically increasing acute kidney injury risk and hyperkalemia.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, BUN) and electrolytes (K+, Mg2+) closely; consider temporary lisinopril discontinuation during amphotericin B therapy or use liposomal amphotericin B formulation with careful volume management.
